## Pricing (Trader Development Program)

**Notes**

- All prices are **USD**.
- Programs are **skills assessments on simulated accounts**.
- Key evaluation rules are listed below.

### Core rules / features

```{r}
features <- data.frame(
  Feature = c(
    "Hedging and News Trading is Allowed",
    "Layering not allowed",
    "Minimum trading days 5",
    "Daily drawdown 5%",
    "Maximum drawdown 8%",
    "Leverage 1:100"
  ),
  Included = c(TRUE, FALSE, TRUE, TRUE, TRUE, TRUE)
)

knitr::kable(features)
```

### Pricing tiers and account sizes

```{r}
pricing <- data.frame(
  Tier = c(
    rep("Step 1", 7),
    rep("Step 2", 7),
    rep("Instant", 7)
  ),
  AccountSizeUSD = c(
    3000, 5000, 10000, 50000, 100000, 200000, 500000,
    3000, 5000, 10000, 50000, 100000, 200000, 500000,
    3000, 5000, 10000, 50000, 100000, 200000, 500000
  ),
  DiscountedPriceUSD = c(
    14, 23, 32, 49, 103, 145, 240,
    9, 14, 23, 42, 82, 123, 200,
    29, 38, 50, 91, 180, 323, 900
  )
)

pricing$AccountSizeUSD <- format(pricing$AccountSizeUSD, big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE)
pricing$RealPriceUSD <- sprintf("%.2f", pricing$DiscountedPriceUSD * 1.65)
knitr::kable(pricing)
```

### Available payment methods

```{r}
payment_methods <- data.frame(
  Method = c("USDT", "Bitcoin", "Ethereum", "Google Pay", "Apple Pay")
)
knitr::kable(payment_methods)
```

## Affiliate / Partner Account

### Overview

Join the partner program and earn competitive commissions by referring traders to GenzProp.

### Partner benefits

```{r}
benefits <- data.frame(
  Benefit = c(
    "Revenue Sharing",
    "Marketing Support",
    "Dedicated Support",
    "Real-Time Analytics"
  ),
  Description = c(
    "Earn competitive commissions on every trader you refer. The more traders you bring, the more you earn.",
    "Access to professional marketing materials, banners, and promotional content to help you succeed.",
    "Get dedicated partner support to help you maximize your earnings and grow your business.",
    "Track your referrals, commissions, and performance with a comprehensive partner dashboard."
  )
)

knitr::kable(benefits)
```

### Partner types (affiliate accounts)

```{r}
partner_types <- data.frame(
  PartnerType = c("Affiliate Partner", "IB Partner", "Institutional Partner"),
  Commission = c("Up to 20%", "Up to 30%", "Custom"),
  Description = c(
    "Perfect for content creators, bloggers, and marketers who want to earn commissions by referring traders.",
    "Ideal for experienced traders and trading communities who can provide value-added services to their clients.",
    "For businesses, trading schools, and institutions looking to offer funding programs to their clients."
  )
)

knitr::kable(partner_types)
```

### How it works (steps)

```{r}
steps <- data.frame(
  Step = c(1, 2, 3, 4),
  Title = c("Apply", "Review", "Onboarding", "Start Earning"),
  Description = c(
    "Fill out the partner application form with your details and business information.",
    "The team reviews your application and gets back to you within 48 hours.",
    "Get access to your partner dashboard, marketing materials, and tracking tools.",
    "Begin referring traders and earning commissions. Payouts are processed monthly."
  )
)

knitr::kable(steps)
```
